domain_sources.source_lock_verification_note: Regulation (EU) 2024/1689 remains a binding EU Regulation. Article 14 addresses effective human oversight for high-risk AI; Annex III includes specified creditworthiness and life/health-insurance use cases.

domain_usage.supports: Risk-based AI regulatory framework including relevant Annex III financial use cases.
domain_usage.does_not_support: AI credit scoring is universally prohibited.
